package: WP15 OPDS publication and cancellation review repairs
fixes: POSIX no-replace refuses publication when hard-link atomic creation fails; ordinary rename is never used as a fallback
Cancellation after verifier completion, including verifier-returned OPDS_CANCELLED, removes the temporary file and prevents publication
Existing destination comparison polls cancellation per bounded read and reads at most downloaded byte length plus one
Cancellation is checked after destination comparison, including identical-file success, and immediately before atomic publication

negative_test_method.network_cases: Original real loopback HTTP service and real SDK verifier; verifier arms deterministic control callbacks after download
negative_test_method.filesystem: Compile production opds_fs.c with only link/MoveFileExW substituted to report unsupported atomic publication
filesystem_assertions: Missing destination remains missing on primitive failure
Temporary input bytes remain intact for caller cleanup
Another writer's destination bytes remain intact
Normal existing-target conflict preserves both files
Explicit replace still publishes complete bytes

history.role: Original OPDS delivery; retained, no results overwritten
Earlier repair run; both platforms passed; final acceptance uses only 39714210896

scope_boundaries: No HTTPS transport implementation added; reference socket transport still returns OPDS_NEEDS_HOST
Verifier and local filesystem operations remain synchronous; cancellation is cooperative between operations
A cancellation that arrives after the atomic publication commit does not roll back published content
Filesystems without atomic no-replace support now return OPDS_IO rather than a weaker publication guarantee
Original WP15 documented exclusions, including LCP, borrowing, payment and host UI integration, remain
integration: Merge this review branch after the original OPDS delivery. Preserve standalone ownership evidence; integration owner chooses the reviewed --handoff base for final combined-source validation.
